review.decision: Separate current Live reset metadata from presentation of earlier HQ turns.
review.notes: Use synthetic pane and transcript reads and mounted RN views; no physical gesture claims.

cases.description: Changing the current HQ session retires the reader even when only earlier turns remain
cases.setup: Mount HQ with the production HTTP client, request the previous session and freeze Live at 276 points.
cases.action: Change reset generation on the same pane while the joined response contains only predecessor A; then read B again and return its first turn.
cases.expected: A remains readable as history. Its frozen viewport retires. Reopening B survives subsequent B polls and the first B turn.
